description: Loads Governed SDD documents when the phase that needs them begins and points agents to the bounded ADR, specification, and queue readers.
delta: Each routed implementation, review, and remediation procedure gains a phase-reads block that states, per document, whether it is read at start or at the phase that needs it, and a bounded-context-readers block that directs ADR and specification reads through meridian context authority and meridian adr show and queue reads through the queue briefing. The status policy gains a phase-reads block and its minimal-read-only-status block names the briefing and the bounded ADR readers. No acceptance criterion, gate, role, or review rule is removed or relaxed; only the time at which a document is read and the way ADRs are read change.
verification: a clean Governed SDD upgrade installs phase-reads v1 and bounded-context-readers v1 in the three role procedures and minimal-read-only-status v2 in the context policy while preserving consumer-owned text
meridian context size reports each deferred document separately and leaves it out of the startup total
marker baselines record the new and bumped capability versions for all managed paths
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
